description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tunning, type = small” illustrates how WER changes over training epochs for four configurations labeled in the legend. The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at every 1 epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 25.0 to 42.5 with regularly spaced tick labels every 2.5 units. Four orange lines are shown: (1) “small AdaLoRA_int4” is a solid line with circle markers, decreasing overall from about 35.6 at epoch 0 to about 30.6 at epoch 6, with intermediate values around 34.8 (epoch 1), 33.8 (epoch 2), 33.0 (epoch 3), 32.2 (epoch 4), and 31.4 (epoch 5). (2) “small AdaLoRA_int8” is a solid line with square markers, moving from about 30.1 at epoch 0 to about 25.1 at epoch 6, passing through approximately 29.9 (epoch 1), 28.7 (epoch 2), 28.2 (epoch 3), 27.4 (epoch 4), and 26.6 (epoch 5). (3) “small int4” is a dashed line with circle markers, rising from about 35.6 at epoch 0 to a peak near 42.3 at epoch 2, then declining to about 31.6 by epoch 6, with points around 40.1 (epoch 1), 38.7 (epoch 3), 36.4 (epoch 4), and 34.1 (epoch 5). (4) “small int8” is a dashed line with square markers, increasing from about 30.1 at epoch 0 to about 33.2 at epoch 1 and about 33.7 at epoch 2, then dropping to about 29.5 at epoch 3 and continuing down to about 25.0 at epoch 6, with intermediate values near 27.4 (epoch 4) and 25.5 (epoch 5).
